results.title: The House of Dona Carlota
results.overview: Based on a true story, Dona Carlota leads a women’s soccer team from the suburbs of Rio de Janeiro on an international tour. Her home, which serves as the club’s headquarters and a space of freedom for the young women, challenges the prevailing morality and the dictatorship of the 1940s.

results.title: Influenca: Controlling Crowds
results.overview: A selfish Influencer and her clumsy Fan Girl/Assistant start an odd relationship that becomes more grotesque day by day.

results.title: The Scam Artisan
results.overview: Day by day, sharp and manipulative Jordon Teaspoon sells modern or as some say: "scam" art to his wealthy, high paying clients. Teaspoon's business is booming as usual, until an old client resurfaces threatening the existence of the phony life Jordon has built.

results.title: Forever Your Maternal Animal
results.overview: After years studying in Europe, Elsa returns to Costa Rica to reunite with her family. She finds her younger sister living alone in the family home, growing increasingly distant and reclusive, as if slipping into a world of her own. Their parents, meanwhile, are absorbed in their own lives. Her father drifts through a series of affairs, while her mother is immersed in republishing the erotic poems of her youth, neither fully grasping the urgency of the situation. Elsa’s return draws the three women into a confrontation with what still binds them, despite everything.

results.title: Family Wanted
results.overview: The film revolves around Farouk (Karim Abdel Aziz), a supermarket manager who is too busy to attend to his home, his wife Mai (Yasmine Sabri), and his children. His wife’s unemployed brother, Galal (Mostafa Khater), moves in with the family, completely turning Farouk's life upside down and dragging him into seemingly unsolvable predicaments—all set against a backdrop of comedy.

results.title: Fishbrain
results.overview: Desperate to escape her decaying coastal town but unable to abandon the grandfather who depends on her, Ori sees a way out when tainted fish wash ashore, but only if she can bring herself to put them on his plate.

results.title: The World Came Flooding In
results.overview: The World Came Flooding In is an immersive VR documentary reconstructing memories of the eastern Australia floods in 2022, which is representative of similar events that happened recently in various parts of the world.

results.title: Vampire Carnival
results.overview: When a grief-stricken young woman visits a mysterious, traveling carnival in her small town, she becomes seduced into a dangerous world of pleasure and deception.

results.title: My First Love
results.overview: Young singer Paulinho goes viral online with an old song written for his first love, Nina. Upon seeing the video's success, Nina reappears with a proposal: Paulinho must perform "pagode" shows to save her father's failing bridal shop. In exchange, she promises to help him find a new girlfriend. He accepts the deal to hide the fact that he still has feelings for her, but their forced proximity reignites their old romance.

results.title: Sapiens
results.overview: Na Do-han, a man with Dissociative Identity Disorder, shares his body with four different identities. One dawn, he wakes up in a motel with blood-soaked hands and the word 'Run!' scrawled on a mirror. Soon linked to the disappearance of a wealthy corporate heir, Do-han becomes the prime suspect. Concurrently pursued by corporate lawyer Seo Hee-jae, he must interrogate his own identities, each concealing a secret.

results.title: Sinner
results.overview: When the ostensibly unblemished prosecutor Kim Seokgyu is nominated for Minister of Justice, the opposition party raises questions about the 1994 "Migeum Arson-Murder Case." They allege that he conducted a coercive investigation against the illiterate suspect Hong Sunhwa and sought the death penalty; however, the crisis passes when a letter left by her comes to light. Yet, after belatedly reading her plea for her innocence to be conveyed to her son Eunsu, Seokgyu begins to reinvestigate the closed case. A prosecutor who once sought justice only within documents and courtroom walls confronts the truths he had overlooked through the voices of those involved.

results.title: Fausse note
results.overview: In Paris, in 1990, an internationally renowned conductor gives his farewell concert at the Opéra-Comique. After the performance, an admirer manages to approach him. What seemed to be a chance encounter gradually transforms into a tense confrontation, revealing a long-buried shared past. As the night unfolds, memory, guilt, and the quest for justice resurface.

results.title: All About Corinne
results.overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.

results.title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
results.original_title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
results.overview: It’s Halloween, and Ducobu is back for an adventure filled with laughter and mystery! Professor Latouche and Miss Rateau move into a house haunted by the ghost of Anatole, the biggest dunce in the history of Saint-Potache School. This mischievous ghost will drag Ducobu, Léonie, their parents, and Kitrish into a series of hilarious and unexpected adventures. But beware: on Halloween, anything can happen!

results.title: The First Taste of Loneliness
results.overview: A single mother has the idea of restarting her marriage life. During the process of contacting different men around her, she felt confused and did not know where to go. Until the emotions buried in her past memories were awakened, she finally found her own answer.

results.title: Other Mommy
results.overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

results.title: Downwind
results.overview: Smokestacks rise like organ pipes over a coastal city, lined with oil refineries. Accidents at the plants occur with troubling regularity, and environmental disaster has become part of daily life. Residents protest the refinery’s planned expansion, even as they must coexist with the very neighbors who work there.

results.title: Love of Your Life
results.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

results.title: The Social Reckoning
results.overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.
